title: Meet the Populist Democrat Who Could Help Flip The Senate
author: John Harwood
content:
This year's Ohio senate race is becoming one of the most high-stakes and high-
dollar races in the battle for Senate control, as Republicans spend
[millions](https://www.cleveland.com/news/2026/04/senate-gops-super-pac-makes-
ohio-its-top-spending-priority-in-2026.html) defending GOP Senator and staunch
Trump supporter Jon Husted against the comeback attempt by former Democratic
Senator **Sherrod Brown**.

Brown is putting up a
[fight](https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/2026-election/republican-concerns-
mount-sen-jon-husted-ohio-rcna594581),
[challenging](https://abcnews.com/Politics/backlash-data-centers-cost-gop-
senate-seat-ohio/story?id=135782050) Husted on his support for [data
center](https://zeteo.com/p/data-centers-ai-7-things-to-know) expansion, and
promising to serve the working class. He joins **Zeteo 's John Harwood** in a
Substack live conversation, where **Zeteo** subscribers could tune in in real
time.
